observations: Front view shows a black DSLR camera with 'Nikon' branding on the prism and 'D610' on the body.
The rubber grip on the front right of the camera appears to be peeling or worn.
A Nikon body cap is attached to the lens mount.
Top view shows the control panel LCD is active, displaying '(- E -)', which typically indicates no memory card is inserted.
The mode dial and top buttons are visible; the hot shoe shows signs of paint wear.
Photos 0 and 1 appear to be identical images.
The rear of the camera, including the main LCD and buttons, is not shown.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI MUHAMMED TUNJI' is visible on all photos.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the camera showing the LCD screen and buttons.
Photo of the image sensor with the body cap removed.

response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Nikon D610 despite the seller's contradictory text claiming it is a Canon. It can be priced at its worst-case condition (non-functional) until further proof is provided.
